findings.message: tasks.md 6.2 claims the 50 budget rows come 'from `test/benchmarks/fixtures`', but that directory holds only `overBudget.json` and `underBudget.json` (benchmark-report fixtures with entries like {"name": "op a", "median": 1}). The 50 rows are built by `buildBudgetLocations(BUDGET_ROW_COUNT)` from `test/features/locations/steps/rowBudgetWorld`, as `test/benchmarks/rowPresenting.bench.ts` imports them. Fix the task to name the real helper.

tasks.md 1.2 and design.md D4 introduce the three-level locale keys `locations.wallTimeHint.gap` and `locations.wallTimeHint.ambiguous`. `.claude/rules/i18n.md` says 'Use flat two-level namespacing: `domain.specificKey` (e.g., `city.searchPlaceholder`)', and every existing key in `locales/en.json` is two-level. Rename them to flat keys, e.g. `locations.wallTimeHintGap` / `locations.wallTimeHintAmbiguous`, everywhere they appear (proposal, design, tasks).

proposal.md M1 says '(21 of 21 ids)', but the ids it lists (FR1–FR13, NFR-P1, NFR-A1–NFR-A4, NFR-R1–NFR-R2, UX1–UX3) are 23, and the traceability loop in tasks.md 8.1 checks 23 ids. The metric's concrete number is wrong; it should read 23 of 23.

findings.message: tasks.md does not cover M6. The proposal promises 'Mutation score of the new or changed model, presenter, controller and view code ≥ 95% (minimum 90%), in scoped Stryker runs of at most 5 files each', but the scoped runs in tasks 2.5, 3.5 and 5.4 leave out files the tasks change: model/locationCommands.ts (new, task 2.1/2.2), presenter/presentLocationRows.ts and presenter/presentHereEntry.ts (pass cityLabel, task 3.4), views/shared/LocationRow.tsx, views/shared/HereEntryRow.tsx, views/shared/LocationList.tsx and views/cards/CardsView.tsx (bind targets and pass confirmWallTime, task 5.3). Add scoped --mutate runs of at most 5 files for them, or narrow M6 to the files that are actually mutated.

Task 4.1 changes useLocations to put wallClockNote into rowsContext (design D2: 'useLocations puts the note into LocationRowsContext'), but every listed test is in controller/useReferenceMoment.test.tsx; useLocations.test.tsx is only run as a regression check. No automated test names this behaviour. Add a case, for example in a new useLocations.wallTime.test.tsx, asserting that rowsContext.wallClockNote is ROW with the target after a GAP wall-time input and NONE after Now.
